adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/constants.ts`, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, which in JS/TS evaluates to a `string | undefined` (the second env var’s string when both are set), not a normalized boolean. The new call sites in this diff rely on truthiness checks like `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)` and `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && ...)`, which work at runtime, so it’s not a direct functional bug. However, the finding is grounded: exporting a non-boolean “enabled flag” leaks a non-boolean type and can cause future type friction or incorrect strict comparisons (`=== true`).
